column1: # Pick swaps and protections: a PORTION of a draft pick changing hands (lotg_support.pick_conditions).
# kind = protected_pick      : the pick leg in that trade was handed over protected — to_owner gets it unless it
#                              lands in protected_slots; then he gets orig_owner's same-round pick in rollover_year
#                              instead (blank rollover_year = orig_owner keeps it). The pick leg itself is a normal
#                              pick hop (Sleeper or data/commissioner_pick_trades.csv); this row values it as the
#                              unprotected part only.
#        protection_removal  : to_owner (already holding the protected pick) gets the protected part — a separate
#                              asset on that trade. If that trade carries a leg of the SAME pick (Sleeper recorded
#                              the pick moving only when the protection came off) the build drops that leg: the
#                              pick moved in the protected_pick trade.
#        better_of           : to_owner gets ONE pick from from_owner: the better (earlier slot) of the orig_owner
#                              and other_orig_owner picks. No pick hop moves (which one is unknown until the slots
#                              are set); the ledger keeps both picks where they are.
#        swap                : to_owner gets the better (earlier slot) of the orig_owner pick he holds and the
#                              other_orig_owner pick from_owner holds; from_owner gets the worse. `after` instead of
#                              other_orig_owner = the pick from_owner is left with after that earlier swap.
# Value = the expectation over every assignment of distinct slots (1..8
